scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of the default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false) and not the author's working copy. QGIS plugin plus marimo notebooks (Python); a shell script (qgis-env.sh) is present and full interface/data-access detection for shell is out of scope for skill version 1.0 (read only for env vars/hosts). Notebooks in example/, notebooks/ are marimo apps (Python) and were read for imports only. Binary data files (example/example.gpkg, notebooks/stations.gpkg, example/spatialite.db) were not inspected. Routes listed are the localhost bridge server in the plugin; authenticated routes carry severity null (no finding). The plugin launches 'python -m marimo edit <notebook>' as a subprocess and can run pip install into QGIS's Python; those are capabilities noted in the capability summary, not scored as findings.

what_this_app_can_do: Runs marimo reactive notebooks on QGIS's own Python interpreter, launched from a dock inside QGIS.

Exposes a token-protected localhost HTTP bridge that lets notebooks read the open QGIS project (layers, features, extent, selection), insert layers back into it, and run any QGIS Processing algorithm.
Installs marimo and any packages the user names into QGIS's Python with pip, and can download example notebooks from GitHub.
Scaffolds new notebook files and writes launch logs to disk.

data_sources_touched.source: Open QGIS project layers (via local bridge)

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Desktop use only. The bridge binds 127.0.0.1 on a random port and requires a per-session bearer token on every request, so it is reachable only by local processes that know the token. Notebooks themselves can run arbitrary Python as the QGIS user.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: POST /api/run executes any Processing algorithm with caller-supplied parameters (guarded only by the local bearer token).
Notebooks launched by the plugin execute arbitrary Python on QGIS's interpreter by design.
pip installs of unpinned packages into the QGIS Python environment at run time.

top_findings: No severity-tagged findings: all bridge routes require a bearer token and bind 127.0.0.1
Unpinned pandas/numpy in pyproject.toml; runtime pip installs into QGIS Python
Local bridge can run arbitrary Processing algorithms
